question: Using the Human Protein Atlas, study all FDA approved drug-target genes with strictly positive consensus RNA nTPM and tissue mass-spectrometry Intensity in both kidney and colon. Report the initial drug-target count and the number retained after each measurement requirement. For retained genes calculate log2(kidney/colon) separately for RNA and protein; give their Spearman correlation and counts in the four positive/negative direction combinations, reporting exact-zero changes separately. Rank the twelve largest absolute differences between the RNA and protein log2 ratios. Give their Ensembl IDs, symbols, four measurements, both ratios, secretome location and main subcellular locations. Draw an RNA-versus-protein fold-change scatter, a direction-count bar chart and a heatmap of those twelve genes' two fold changes; provide the plotted data. Break ranking ties by Ensembl ID. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

turns.text: Every gene has a row for kidney and colon in the RNA consensus table. Now let me compute the stage-wise counts for FDA-approved drug-target genes.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "WITH fda AS (
  SELECT "Ensembl" AS ens, "Gene" AS sym FROM proteinatlas
  WHERE "Ensembl" IS NOT NULL AND "Ensembl"!='' AND "Protein class" LIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%'
),
rnk AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) AS rna_k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN TRY_CAST("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) AS rna_c
  FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE "Tissue" IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
),
msk AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) AS ms_k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN TRY_CAST("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) AS ms_c
  FROM ms_tissue WHERE "Tissue" IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS fda_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rna_k IS NOT NULL AND rna_k>0 AND rna_c IS NOT NULL AND rna_c>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fda_rna_both_pos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (rna_k IS NOT NULL AND rna_k>0 AND rna_c IS NOT NULL AND rna_c>0)
                AND (ms_k IS NOT NULL AND ms_k>0 AND ms_c IS NOT NULL AND ms_c>0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fda_rna_ms_both_pos
FROM fda f
LEFT JOIN rnk r ON r."Gene"=f.ens
LEFT JOIN msk m ON m."Gene"=f.ens"}

turns.text: Now I have the retention counts. Let me build the full dataset for the 214 retained genes with their measurements and log2 ratios.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "WITH fda AS (
  SELECT "Ensembl" AS ens, "Gene" AS sym FROM proteinatlas
  WHERE "Ensembl" IS NOT NULL AND "Ensembl"!='' AND "Protein class" LIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%'
),
rnk AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) AS rna_k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN TRY_CAST("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) AS rna_c
  FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE "Tissue" IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
),
msk AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) AS ms_k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN TRY_CAST("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) AS ms_c
  FROM ms_tissue WHERE "Tissue" IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
)
SELECT f.ens, f.sym, r.rna_k, r.rna_c, m.ms_k, m.ms_c,
  LN(r.rna_k/r.rna_c)/LN(2) AS rna_log2,
  LN(m.ms_k/m.ms_c)/LN(2) AS prot_log2
FROM fda f
JOIN rnk r ON r."Gene"=f.ens
JOIN msk m ON m."Gene"=f.ens
WHERE r.rna_k>0 AND r.rna_c>0 AND m.ms_k>0 AND m.ms_c>0
ORDER BY f.ens"}

turns.text: I now have the full 214-gene dataset. Let me compute the Spearman correlation and the direction-combination counts.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "WITH fda AS (
  SELECT "Ensembl" AS ens FROM proteinatlas WHERE "Protein class" LIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%'
),
rnk AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) AS rna_k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN TRY_CAST("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) AS rna_c
  FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE "Tissue" IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
),
msk AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) AS ms_k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN TRY_CAST("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) AS ms_c
  FROM ms_tissue WHERE "Tissue" IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
),
d AS (
  SELECT f.ens,
    LN(r.rna_k/r.rna_c)/LN(2) AS rna_log2,
    LN(m.ms_k/m.ms_c)/LN(2) AS prot_log2
  FROM fda f
  JOIN rnk r ON r."Gene"=f.ens
  JOIN msk m ON m."Gene"=f.ens
  WHERE r.rna_k>0 AND r.rna_c>0 AND m.ms_k>0 AND m.ms_c>0
)
SELECT
  corr(rr, pr) AS spearman,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rna_log2>0 AND prot_log2>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rna_log2>0 AND prot_log2<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pn,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rna_log2<0 AND prot_log2>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS np,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rna_log2<0 AND prot_log2<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nn,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rna_log2=0 OR prot_log2=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_any,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rna_log2=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_rna,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prot_log2=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_prot,
  COUNT(*) AS n
FROM (
  SELECT rna_log2, prot_log2,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rna_log2) AS rr,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY prot_log2) AS pr
  FROM d
) t"}

d AS (

    LN(r.rna_k/r.rna_c)/LN(2) AS rna_log2,

WITH fda AS (
  SELECT "Ensembl" AS ens, "Gene" AS sym FROM proteinatlas
  WHERE "Ensembl" IS NOT NULL AND "Ensembl"!='' AND "Protein class" LIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%'
),
rnk AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) AS rna_k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN TRY_CAST("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) AS rna_c
  FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE "Tissue" IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
),
msk AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) AS ms_k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN TRY_CAST("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) AS ms_c
  FROM ms_tissue WHERE "Tissue" IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS fda_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rna_k IS NOT NULL AND rna_k>0 AND rna_c IS NOT NULL AND rna_c>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fda_rna_both_pos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (rna_k IS NOT NULL AND rna_k>0 AND rna_c IS NOT NULL AND rna_c>0)
                AND (ms_k IS NOT NULL AND ms_k>0 AND ms_c IS NOT NULL AND ms_c>0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fda_rna_ms_both_pos
FROM fda f
LEFT JOIN rnk r ON r."Gene"=f.ens
LEFT JOIN msk m ON m."Gene"=f.ens

WITH fda AS (
  SELECT "Ensembl" AS ens, "Gene" AS sym FROM proteinatlas
  WHERE "Ensembl" IS NOT NULL AND "Ensembl"!='' AND "Protein class" LIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%'
),
rnk AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) AS rna_k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN TRY_CAST("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) AS rna_c
  FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE "Tissue" IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
),
msk AS (

    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) AS ms_k,

  FROM ms_tissue WHERE "Tissue" IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"

SELECT f.ens, f.sym, r.rna_k, r.rna_c, m.ms_k, m.ms_c,

WITH fda AS (
  SELECT "Ensembl" AS ens FROM proteinatlas WHERE "Protein class" LIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%'
),
rnk AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) AS rna_k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN TRY_CAST("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) AS rna_c
  FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE "Tissue" IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
),
msk AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) AS ms_k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN TRY_CAST("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) AS ms_c
  FROM ms_tissue WHERE "Tissue" IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
),
d AS (
  SELECT f.ens,
    LN(r.rna_k/r.rna_c)/LN(2) AS rna_log2,
    LN(m.ms_k/m.ms_c)/LN(2) AS prot_log2
  FROM fda f
  JOIN rnk r ON r."Gene"=f.ens
  JOIN msk m ON m."Gene"=f.ens
  WHERE r.rna_k>0 AND r.rna_c>0 AND m.ms_k>0 AND m.ms_c>0
)
SELECT
  corr(rr, pr) AS spearman,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rna_log2>0 AND prot_log2>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rna_log2>0 AND prot_log2<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pn,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rna_log2<0 AND prot_log2>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS np,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rna_log2<0 AND prot_log2<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nn,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rna_log2=0 OR prot_log2=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_any,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rna_log2=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_rna,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prot_log2=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_prot,
  COUNT(*) AS n
FROM (
  SELECT rna_log2, prot_log2,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rna_log2) AS rr,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY prot_log2) AS pr
  FROM d
) t

),
rnk AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) AS rna_k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN TRY_CAST("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) AS rna_c
  FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE "Tissue" IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
),
msk AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) AS ms_k,

),
d AS (
  SELECT f.ens,
    r.rna_k, r.rna_c, m.ms_k, m.ms_c,
    LN(r.rna_k/r.rna_c)/LN(2) AS rna_log2,
    LN(m.ms_k/m.ms_c)/LN(2) AS prot_log2,
    ABS(LN(r.rna_k/r.rna_c)/LN(2) - LN(m.ms_k/m.ms_c)/LN(2)) AS abs_diff
